title: Tejo (Turmequé)
tagline: Slide to aim, throw the steel disc, sink the ring and pop the mechas.
description: Colombia's national target sport. Slide to place a target mark on the clay box, lift to throw a heavy steel disc, and score the brass ring, the confetti-popping paper mechas and the closest disc. Four computer opponents, two players, practice, Think and Watch & Learn.
howToPlay: Press anywhere and slide your thumb to move the target mark.
Lift your thumb to throw; the dashed circle shows the scatter.
Ring 6 points, each paper mecha 3, ring plus pop 9.
After six discs the one nearest the ring scores 1.
Tap Think for a tested suggestion.
